excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.name: EVcharge / Etecnic
excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.reason: Official EVcharge/Etecnic material describes a charge-point management SaaS/platform used by municipalities, companies and other operators, with customer-configurable tariffs by time, power and user group. Do not count the platform name itself as a physical CPO or propagate one tariff across stations unless a specific station's physical operator is independently identified.

excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.name: Electromaps / Electromaps SL
excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.reason: Electromaps' current official FAQ states charging tariffs are set by the station owner or CPO, may vary by kWh/minute/fixed fee, and Electromaps can add its own service surcharge. Treat Electromaps as an eMSP/aggregation platform for tariff purposes, not as a physical CPO identity to which one direct tariff can be propagated. Resolve the underlying physical CPO per station/EVSE instead.
